strings.en: Playing defense just isn't my style!
As PTX Team's captain, I'd better look good.
I haven't been through all those fights for nothing!
I know my way around/　a Gespenst!
Have a taste of the Kai model's power!
It's not just the looks/　that got an upgrade!
I'm counting on you, Exbein Boxer!
Let's show 'em what the improved Gunner can do!
Cutting in with the Gespenst Haken!
If it's power you want, I've got plenty!
Guys like that always think/　they're the ones who won't die...
Show me the skills Calvina taught you!
Messing with us never ends well, you know?
Jua-Mu, women hate a guy who won't take a hint!
In a way, aren't you letting/　your feelings carry you away too...!
There are skilled fighters everywhere, huh...!
Don't just deal with Calvina,/　deal with me too!
Every beautiful rose has its thorns, huh!
I'd rather not have met you like this.
Every beautiful rose has its thorns, eh!
If you weren't the enemy, I'd be hitting on you already.
Karo-Ran, you're the one/　with death written on your face!
A villain going after a princess/　is a classic in Earth fairy tales...!
In Earth fairy tales,/　the villain always gets taken down!
I'll tear off that mask of yours!
Hope you're ready to take a loss!
If you think it'll all go as calculated, you're dead wrong!
Geez... she's a troublesome type of woman.
Baran-Schneil.../　What a handful of a woman, really!
That guy's the boss of Golaikunru...?
Hmph, the mastermind makes his entrance./　Better welcome him.
We can't exactly back down either!
Vort, I've got some confidence in my skills too!
That woman's seen it all, hasn't she?
A little past her prime, but she's quite a woman.
I do like a strong-willed woman, but...!
Herluga, too much power will destroy you!
Hey now,/　bigger isn't always better, you know.
So that's what's left of the Dark Brain's forces...!
You'll be playing the clown, Debudedabide!
Does that thing have something/　to do with ancient Egypt?
Whatever the cause, I can't shoot it down.
I need to think about where to aim...
To think even Zovorg machines are being controlled.
If it's unmanned, I won't hold back!
Geez, just how many Zovorg machines are there?
Well, they're still the enemy either way.
Madnet can control just about anything, huh.
This isn't my first time fighting a dragon!
If it's called Crystal, it must be pretty tough.
It's like a monster movie, this.
Got quite the mug on you, don't you?
Dark Brain's officers are a bunch of oddballs...!
Are you sure you're getting/　enough calcium?
Making everything efficient isn't always/　the answer!
XN-L! You don't get to decide who lives or dies!
Quit meddling with other people's planets!
If you want to do business, go elsewhere!
Even an artillery type is easy once I know its tricks!
Best to destroy that type quickly!
Whoa, the road's closed from here on!
That commander unit is a bit of a tough one.
Even a thick barrage has its holes.
Mekibos never told me anything about a new model.
Moves pretty well for a bioroid soldier.
When it comes to fighting humanoids,/　I've got some experience too!
Let's test the new model's performance!
Time for you to make an early exit, Fury!
I'll take on that Big Shoulder!
I'll take you on, White Horn!
I'd be surprised if a thing that looks like that/　wasn't a commander unit.
I'm used to getting pricked by thorns!
Time to go after the Commander!
The nail that sticks out gets hammered!
Taking out the flashy ones first!
Gadisword, I won't let you do as you please!
Guess I'll take on that Gadisword unit!
We sure attract monsters like that, huh?
It looks kind of like a ghost, but...!
Best to get rid of unclean things fast!
Gotta finish off the Lamaris quick!
I can't waste time on the Lamaris!
Gotta wipe out the Kaana types!
We sure have a knack for running into/　ghouls and goblins.
Well, it got bigger, so it's easier to hit.
Against an Ida type,/　I'd better put my back into it!
Well, guess I'll help out/　a princess instead of a prince!
Can't let a bunch of lowlifes/　use it...!
Not knowing when to quit is my one flaw!
I'm not nice enough to just take that!
Well, mustn't overdo the service... Hup!
Your luck ran out when I set my eyes on you!
It'd be rude not to give anything back.
Ngh! Well, this is a fine mess...
Well,/　a pinch like this is par for the course!
Didn't see that coming,/　but now things are getting fun!
What?! They had this kind of power?!
Ngh! Should I be glad I'm alive?!
...Now then, time to turn the tables!
Dammit, I took way too many hits!
As PTX Team's captain,/　I can't let myself look bad!
What?!/　It punched through the Grungust's armor?!
Heh, we've been through a lot, partner.../　Wait, this is no time for that!
A fight's not over until it's over, Herluga!
Getting cornered by Zovorg small fry.../　I must be losing my touch...!
And we're the ones who have to beat that thing...!
Ngh, no wonder Skull Knight and his lot/　want to use it...!
Tch... Are my moves being read?
Ugh! Nah, I'm just getting started!
All as predicted so far./　Guess it's time I got serious!
Whoa! Now that's more like it!
Sorry, but I've walked through/　a lot more hell than you have!
Guess I got a little too cocky...
Hmm... Not a good look for me.
I've still got plenty of room!
If you can keep up with the Grungust,/　at least I won't get bored.
Took a hit from the Roundel Wing!
I didn't upgrade that part, dammit!
Yikes.../　Never thought the Gespenst/　would get torn up this badly.
Well.../　This kind of danger comes with this machine.
The Boxer's armor should hold a bit longer!
Hmph, I'll give you some credit, Jua-Mu.
Ngh! I can't keep up with the Raftclans!
Tch! No time for flirting like this.
I'd like a little more gentleness toward a lady.
One harsh woman is plenty for me...
Don't think you can become emperor/　without beating us...!
Young, handsome, and rich, huh?/　Not that I'm jealous.
A woman's pride, is it, Reggiane!
Words don't really bother me much, though.
She's my type, but this is a bit much.
Tch, how am I supposed to pry that thing/　away from the Cross Gate...?!
Moves pretty well for something being controlled!
Ngh, I'm not paying/　for this magic show!
Like I'd become a dragon's tribute!
Ugh! I'm not playing the victim in a monster movie!
Not yet! I'm just getting started, XN-L!
Well, they probably have our data too.
Seems the Fury have some skilled ones too!
I won't let the unknowns get any closer!
Tch, I can't afford to waste time/　on that Lamaris!
I didn't think I was intimidated by its looks...!
That size explains/　all this power, but...!
Ugh! Its attacks are heavier than before!
Even a monkey can land a hit.
Hah! Just as I thought./　That's all you've got.
Geez.../　Guess I haven't improved much myself.
With more juniors around,/　I can't let 'em see me look bad.
Eh, this is a piece of cake.
Isn't your push a little weak?
On anything but a Grungust,/　that'd be moderate damage.
For a Kai model, this is within tolerance.
I beefed up the armor, too!
Just the right opponent/　for a Gespenst.
I didn't think I was underestimating/　the Raftclans' mobility...!
Never getting mad at a woman, whatever she does.../　guess that won't work.
That one's faster than the other Raftclans...!
Cute face, but she sure packs a punch.
Handsome and rich... What's his weakness?
I'm totally fine with older women,/　but combat's another story.
Geez, getting tangled up with the Cross Gate/　never ends well.
Hm? That's got more punch/　than its face lets on.
If it were the screaming type, it'd be easier to dodge...!
Things won't go your way, XN-L!
Hm? I've already got the Zovorg unit data/　input, though.
Considering our orders this time,/　this much is expected.
Is that all the Fury's mobile weapons can do?
Not bad, for a machine of their own making.
Tch, I couldn't read that sword!
If it were a cute girl, sure, but/　getting cuddled by a ghost is no fun.
I can't struggle against Kaana types either.
Doesn't look like it's... holding back its power.
Keep the jokes to that face of yours.
Sorry, but I don't have time/　to waste on just you!
I saw through your moves/　a long time ago!
Oh ho, you're really trying, huh?
If you want to hit me, aim better.
The old me might've gotten hit.
It's not just big for show.
Fooled by the Grungust's looks, huh!
I know how to handle this thing.
Guess you underestimated/　the Gespenst's performance!
Sharp thorns, but they're pointless if they don't prick!
I'll have to decline that invitation.
You'll only add to your disgrace, Jua-Mu.
That sharp edge of yours is just...
If the Cross Gate's too much for you, let it go!
Maybe you ought to go on a diet.
I'm the one who slays monsters,/　not the one who gets slain.
We've got plenty of Zovorg machine data.
Attack me as often as you like--/　the result won't change.
You really never learn, do you?
If you're relying on specs,/　you'll never hit me.
Point is, we won't let the Fury do as they please.
I sympathize with your situation, but I can't go easy!
I'd hate to get possessed by something like that.
Whoa there, I don't plan on being/　the one who gets slain.
The Kaana types are closing in...!
Whoa... its burst speed's gone up since last time.
At that rate, a hundred more tries/　won't change a thing.
Close. But a miss is a miss.
I make a point of not/　accepting invitations like that.
Seems Agents show their moves more than you'd think.
You guys have data on us, don't you?
You're not showing off much power, Gu-Landon!
Hey, big shot, you'd better aim a little better.
Working your flesh to the bone... oh right, no flesh.
This isn't a robot show anymore.
Whoa! I've got a barrier, you know.
Sorry, but that was a waste!
I came prepared for this much!
Only girls get to chase me, thanks.
Ladies only--no thanks to the rest!
Out of ammo? Tch, this is the worst.
Guess I was a bit too generous.
Giving too much away has its downside.
Sheesh, quick to run, aren't they?
I pride myself on being quick!
At times like this, stay sharp!
Here, Ryusei... I'll lend you a hand!
Major Kai, leave this to me!
The Major sure likes working me hard.
Kyosuke, leave the rest to me!
Can't have me be the one/　getting escorted, now can we?
You can thank me with a date!
Latune, leave the rest to me!
Cute girls deserve cover, as they say!
Join me for tea later, okay?
I'm no stand-in for Kyosuke, but here goes!
Lamia, leave the rest to me!
Aqua, let your senior handle the rest.
Touya, leave the rest to me!
Leave this to your elder, Akimi!
You lured it over here, Yon!
I'll give you a hand, Sieg!
Leave the rest to me, Sally!
My favors don't come cheap, Haken!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Like I'd let you have your way!
Oh well, guess I'll do my part!
I can't allow that kind of approach!
Leave this one to your big bro!
Well, not that they needed my help...
Protecting a princess is a man's duty!
Just doing my duty as a senior!
Touya, there's a girl on board, so be careful!
This is part of a captain's job too!
Akimi, you didn't read that well enough!
Akemi, pull back while you can!
I don't want Mekibos complaining to me!
Crazy weapon, but/　it packs a serious punch!
Drawn, it scatters jewels... a blade of ice...
This one's a real showy weapon too, huh.
I'll knock you down in one go!
Time to let loose in W Mode!
I'll take care of you all at once!
Once I'm in close, you're mine!
Guess I'll play my trump card!
Melee's the foundation of PT combat!
This time it's a triple feature!
Two baleful stars in the heavens...!
Look to the sky, look to the stars... right?
May the God of Slaughter guide you... kidding.
It's no assassin's sword, so keep that in mind.
Evil stars in a row shatter lucky gods/　and return them to the earth...!
Alright, this one's/　about as ominous as it gets!
Your luck ran out from the very start.
...Maybe I should get myself/　a ward against bad luck too?
A trick only a combining robot can pull!
There's nothing I can't cut.../　Just kidding!
Spam this and I'm in the red!?
This thing's mobility and accuracy/　are no joke! Neither's the price tag!
By the time you notice, it's too late!
Got a good taste of the gravity sword's edge,/　didn't you?
I'd say now's the time to finish it!
Calling this thing a ripper is underselling it.
What a weird weapon they've made.
Now, let's finish it with this!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
...By the way, want to get some tea after this?
Maybe I'll go tattle to Daddy.
I'll burn you to a crisp!
Take that, and that, and that!
An ill star of certain death twinkles in the heavens...
Motion patterns unique to this baby!
It's every bit as destructive as it looks!
Let's go with the Slicer Haken!
Faster than the eye can see!
There, you can't stop it now!
Take that, and that, and that!
